note: Curated decisions that override the catalogue. Keys are store-prefixed (steam:236430) so PlayStation entries can join later.
storeOnlyNote: Owned and shown on the store's own shelf, but not a game Home should list. Hitman: Sniper Challenge was a pre-order promo; IGDB has no record of it.
alsoCountsAsNote: One store entry that is really several games. IGDB records HITMAN World of Assassination as plain Hitman 3, but since 2023 that purchase carries Hitman (2016) and Hitman 2 as well, so it counts as a copy of each. Values name any store entry belonging to the game meant; the app follows it to that game.
titlesNote: Corrects a canonical name. Keys are canonical ids. The Chrono Trigger entry is a temporary test of the update path and will be removed.
linksNote: Which canonical game a store entry is, where the name alone is ambiguous. Both of these are PS3 discs: Demon's Souls is the 2009 game rather than the 2020 remake, and Most Wanted is Criterion's 2012 game rather than the 2005 one.
